{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness web client plugin: group sidebar workspaces into a configurable three-level tree (分类→项目→会话). Sidecar YAML rules. dsh-plugin.","id":"gh:1342196762","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-workspace-groups","slug":"z-col/dsh-workspace-groups","topics":["deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh","dsh-plugin","sidebar","workspace","workspace-groups"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness web client plugin: group sidebar workspaces into a configurable three-level tree (分"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"类→项目→会话). Sidecar YAML rules. dsh-plugin."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"English · 简体中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# dsh-workspace-groups"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web client plugin: a complete workspace grouping manager.**
> Turns the"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" GUI sidebar's two-level workspace list (Projects → Sessions) into a
> three-level **Category folder"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" → Project folder → Session** tree, backed by full
> group-management capabilities: manual group cre"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ation, rename/delete of any group,
> drag-and-drop grouping, free ordering of projects and groups, r"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"ule-based
> auto-classification, and tree-shaped search. Every action takes effect
> **immediately a"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"nd persists**, with **zero intrusion** on official data."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Screenshot"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### Grouped tree browsing
- **Group folder → project folder → session row**, both levels collapsible"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"; expansion state
persists independently (`dsh.workspace.groups.view.v1`, survives refresh/restart)
"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"- **Top-level project rows**: ungrouped projects (matching no rule, dragged out of a group,
or retur"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ned by a group delete) render as plain rows right after the group folders, at the
same level — **the"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"re is no "未分类" bucket**"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### Group management (full lifecycle)
- **Create groups manually**: the "新建分组" button in the section"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" header shows the group
immediately (empty groups render too)
- **Rename / delete any group**: every"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" group row (**rule categories included**) has a hover
`⋯` menu; deleting a group sends all of its pr"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ojects back to the **top level**;
rule-category rename/delete rides the overlay (`renamed` / `hidden"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"`),
**the rule YAML stays untouched**
- **Rule-based auto-classification**: the sidecar YAML declare"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"s category rules (`pathPrefix` /
`pathExact` / `nameContains` / `basenameContains`); edit the config"},{"id":"p8s7","text":" to adjust grouping
without touching code"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Drag-and-drop grouping + ordering
- **Drag projects into groups**: drop on any group row or on a"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" project row inside a group
(cross-group move = overrides the rule classification)
- **Drag projects"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" OUT of a group**: the **entire top-level area** is the move-out drop
target while dragging, shown w"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ith an **insertion line** (not a highlight box) — drop on
any top-level row (reorder before/after it"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"), on the blank space below the last row
(append), or, when the top level is empty, a standalone lin"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"e under the last group
folder; grouped projects also have a "移出分组" menu item (rule-classified ones i"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"ncluded)
- **Reorder projects inside a group**: top half of a project row = insert before it,
bottom"},{"id":"p9s8","text":" half = insert after it
- **Reorder top-level projects**: top-level rows are draggable too — top hal"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"f = insert
before, bottom half = insert after; the top-level order persists under
`workspaceOrder["_"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"_topLevel__"]`
- **Reorder groups**: group rows are draggable — top half of another group row = move"},{"id":"p9s11","text":" before it,
bottom half = move after it
- **Insertion position indicator**: a 2px line (above/below "},{"id":"p9s12","text":"the row) shows the exact drop
point while dragging — what you see is where it lands
- **Level-aware "},{"id":"p9s13","text":"folding, auto-restored**: dragging a project folds every project row
(grouped AND top-level; group r"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"ows stay expanded); dragging a group folds every group
(project rows keep their expansion) — dragend"},{"id":"p9s15","text":" restores the pre-drag expansion snapshot
- **Distinct row icons**: group rows use a folder glyph, p"},{"id":"p9s16","text":"roject rows a project glyph
(same as the official workspace browser) — groups and projects are easy "},{"id":"p9s17","text":" project glyph
(same as the official workspace browser) — groups and projects are easy to tell apart"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Search & operations
- **Tree-shaped search**: results keep the three-level structure (category →"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" project → matched
session), matched rows highlighted with a content snippet, 250ms debounce
- **No "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"regression on workspace/session actions**: Add Workspace, project rename/delete,
session new/open/re"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"kspace/session actions**: Add Workspace, project rename/delete,
session new/open/rename/fork/archive"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Persistence & zero intrusion
- Every manual action (groups, grouping, ordering, rename, hide) is"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" written to the plugin's own
overlay (`~/.dsh/workspace-groups.manual.json`), validated by the host "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"and **written
atomically** (a malformed write returns 400 and keeps the previous file)
- **Zero intr"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"usion**: never touches `~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json`, session on-disk
structures, or the official"},{"id":"p11s5","text":" `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` package; the rule YAML
is never rewritten
- **Self-contained"},{"id":"p11s6","text":" artifact**: `lib/` is prebuilt and shipped with the repo — installing from
Git runs no dependency s"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"act**: `lib/` is prebuilt and shipped with the repo — installing from
Git runs no dependency scripts"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- The plugin is a **client plugin** registered into the official sidebar shell's
`sidebar.workspaces"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"` slot (`kind: 'single'`) at `priority: -1`, replacing the official
WorkspaceBrowser (registered at "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"priority 0; lowest priority wins in a single slot).
- All data comes from the runtime API: the `useW"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"orkspaces` / `useSessions` global hooks and
`ctx.workspaces.*` / `ctx.sessions.*` — grouping is pure"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"ly a **presentation-layer transform**.
- The host half does two things: parses the sidecar YAML and "},{"id":"p13s6","text":"merges it with the runtime
overlay, served to the client via `GET /workspace-groups/config` (`Cache-"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"Control: no-cache`);
and `PUT /workspace-groups/manual` accepts the full overlay (manual groups, per"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"-workspace
grouping overrides, group/project ordering, rule-category renames and hides), validates i"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"t
and writes it atomically to `$DSH_HOME/workspace-groups.manual.json`.
- **Classification priority*"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"*: manual override (written by drag/menu; `null` = forced
top-level, rules ignored) → YAML rule clas"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"sification (hidden rule categories are inert)
→ **top level** (ungrouped projects render as top-leve"},{"id":"p13s12","text":"l rows). The YAML is never
rewritten."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install (GitHub distribution)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> Prerequisite: DeepSeek Harness
> installed (`dsh` available) with a target profile initialized (e."},{"id":"p15s2","text":"g. the built-in `web`)."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"This automatically:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"1. Adds `"dsh-workspace-groups": "github:z-col/dsh-workspace-groups"` (pinned to
version/commit) to "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"`dependencies` in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`
2. Appends `"dsh-workspace-groups"` to `dsh.pro"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"file.bundles`
3. Runs pnpm install and validates the bundle layer"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
